versions.content: Handling/addressing of redundant NVRAM blocks shall be done towards the memory hardware abstraction in the same way like for dataset NVRAM blocks, i.e. the redundant NV blocks shall be managed by usage of the configuration parameter NvMDatasetSelectionBits.
